products.title: ASUS Vivobook 16 HIGH PERFORMANCE Laptop
products.description: The ASUS Vivobook 16 is a high-performance business and work laptop featuring a 16.0-inch IPS WUXGA (1920x1200) display. Powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon X X1-26-100 processor and integrated Qualcomm Adreno graphics, it comes equipped with 16GB of LPDDR5X RAM and a massive 2TB PCIe NVMe SSD for ample storage. This silver-colored laptop includes a backlit keyboard, Windows 11 Pro, and modern connectivity including 802.11ax Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.3. products.title: ACEMAGIC RX16 16" Laptop
products.description: The ACEMAGIC RX16 is a high-performance 16-inch laptop designed for work, study, and entertainment. It is powered by the Intel Core Ultra X7 358H processor with 16 cores and 16 threads, complemented by Intel Arc B390 integrated graphics and a dedicated NPU for AI applications. products.title: Dell Pro 16 Laptop
products.description: The Dell Pro 16 is a professionally upgraded laptop designed for on-the-go professionals, meeting MIL-STD 810H durability standards.
